open_version_questions: Reconcile the matching 2017-09-24 dates printed inside both PDFs and their 2017-09-24 upload timestamps with the ClinicalTrials.gov document metadata date of 2017-11-24; the internal identity chain is accepted provisionally because both uploads predate registry posting and recorded completion.
review_requirements: Confirm the prospective sample-size target and allocation ratio; never use the registry's actual enrollment as the target.
Define one primary outcome and contrast or explicitly control multiplicity across movement, pain and pressure-threshold variables.
Specify a valid pre/post three-arm model, planned contrasts, effect estimates and confidence intervals.
Define the randomized analysis population, missingness, estimand, masking and safety handling.
Do not apply risk reduction or number-needed-to-treat measures mechanically to continuous outcomes.
Verify every locator against one-based rendered physical PDF pages and preserve reference-plan isolation.
